speaker: Bo
text: Na, I'm so upset! My desk lamp just stopped working!

speaker: Na
text: Oh no! How are you going to study now?

speaker: Na
text: I have an old desk lamp. Do you want to buy it? I'll give you a good price!

speaker: Bo
text: That sounds good! How much is it?

speaker: Na
text: That's a little too low. I can give it to you for 80,000 dong.

speaker: Bo
text: Hmm... How about 70,000 dong? Please, Na!

speaker: Na
text: Let me think... Hmm, all right!

speaker: Na
text: You're welcome! I hope you like it.
